question: Which setup stores bind the player-count and excluded-player words, which game-start edge reaches them, and which local helper rebuilds the human mask?

scope.boundary: The count/excluded-index setup producer is reached by a direct call chain from the accepted key-2 game-start entry. Its UI request, new-game-only reachability, ordinary AI omission, excluded-category identity and safe mutation remain unproved.

dependencies.use: Identifies the selected player-count and excluded-player globals.
Separates observed civilization-bearing players 0 through 4 from excluded player 5.
Separates human-mask classification and active-player selection from civilization membership.
Provides setup owner identity and distinguishes eight-element capacity from participant bounds.
Identifies AudioGameStartInit as the accepted key-2 receiving-state entry.
Preserves the unresolved UI request, registration and dynamic state dispatch boundary.

callerBoundary.qualification: The supported-image word 0x4BFFC575 encodes this direct call. Generated exact-function code and repaired-project decompilation corroborate the edge. The setup result -1 bypasses the caller's following local initialization work. UI ingress and new-game-only reachability are not established.

gameStartEntry.result: The accepted AudioGameStartInit entry directly calls the setup caller after its local presentation-audio initialization gate.
gameStartEntry.qualification: The visible gate conditionally initializes audio when 0x8314EFBC is null and byte +0x4 of the object reached through 0x8314F284 is nonzero. A failed audio helper result returns before setup. These fields do not establish new-game versus load semantics. State-key 2 alone is not a new-game discriminator: the accepted gameplay-state observer saw key 2 in both new-game and load transitions. That observation does not establish that this exact game-start entry executed on load.

callerBoundary.nextIngressDiscriminator: An independently anchored UI request, concrete state-owner insertion, or resolved dynamic invocation of the accepted key-2 entry must distinguish new creation from load/reinitialization before assigning new-game-only reachability.

guards: The player-count word, civilization-bearing membership, human mask, excluded category and fixed storage capacity are distinct contracts.
The local stores do not prove new-game-only ingress, a safe participant omission, complete initialization or persistence.
The excluded index has no established barbarian identity in this bounded result.
Retained r16, the override mode and other writers remain outside the recovered local producer.
A clear human-mask bit does not by itself identify an ordinary AI civilization. The separately excluded ordinal and civilization selection must remain distinct.
Key 2 was observed in new-game and load lifecycle, but that does not prove that this exact setup entry executes on load. Its new-game-only ingress remains unresolved.
conclusion: The accepted key-2 game-start entry directly reaches the bounded count/excluded-index setup owner. A separate setup helper rebuilds the human-player mask from a nonzero source word or per-ordinal predicate results. UI request, new-game-only ingress, ordinary AI civilization membership, excluded-category identity, complete initialization and safe omission remain unresolved.

currentEvidence.method: Read-only native instruction words and exact-function decompilation, corroborated with narrow generated windows.
currentEvidence.qualification: Static edges, local audio gating and the selected human-mask producer are corroborated. This result supplies no UI request, resolved dynamic state dispatch, observed load execution of the exact entry, ordinary AI membership, participant omission or runtime mutation.
currentEvidence.imageCheck: All 195 native rows in the three radius-32 windows match the hash-bound supported image. All 57 additional call-chain and mask-producer word rows, 52 unique addresses, also match the same hash-bound image.

setupProducer.conditionalOverride: A nonzero word at 0x8314F180 replaces the count with two at 0x82D22934 and the excluded-player word with retained r16 at 0x82D22938. Neither the mode meaning nor r16's complete provenance is assigned.
setupProducer.qualification: Raw words and generated exact body agree on both stores and conditional override. This does not establish a complete writer inventory or a new-game-only lifecycle.

initializationConsumer.result: The selected per-player initialization arm bypasses work when its index equals the separately stored excluded index.
initializationConsumer.qualification: The complete initialization, civilization assignment, human selection, slot-category identity and gameplay effects remain unresolved.

zeroSourcePath.result: When the source word is zero and count is positive, iterate ordinal zero through count minus one, call the predicate with the loaded receiver and ordinal, and OR that ordinal's bit into the mask when the result is nonzero.

humanMaskProducer.qualification: The accepted human-mask identity and this local writer do not identify ordinary AI membership, civilization selection, excluded-category identity, new-game-only execution or a safe omission. The nonzero source word's producer and the zero-source predicate's actual membership input remain unresolved. The repaired setup body truncates before the selected local call, so raw call-word and narrow generated evidence bind that edge.
humanMaskProducer.nextMembershipDiscriminator: Identify the producer and lifecycle of 0x8314F1B0, or the exact predicate/input contract at 0x82D8AB00 with receiver 0x8314EFE0 and ordinal r4. Independently bind civilization selection through 0x830ECD28 before choosing an ordinary AI to omit.
